THE SESSION'S SPINE. Two CC instances had run in parallel and continuity was lost; both repos were clean, nothing was lost. The owed work was Akien's verbatim 2026-08-05 evening correction: a STACKABLE LEARNING BLOCK IS A QUESTION NEXUS — input, feedback from probes, candidate constraining questions, a domain KB, constraining questions, two loops, output. It has NO findings, NO verdicts, nothing a human comments on. An INSPECTOR is a SUBCLASS whose KB is a list of things to measure; the FINDING is its output slot. VERDICT and DIAL are the HUMAN GATE around an inspector, not organs of a block. My error had promoted the subclass's parts into the parent, uniformly, across five artifacts.
